wins: Make tokens every turn with spirits and saprolings; Intangible Virtue and Sporecrown Thallid turn them into a real army.
plan: Doomed Traveler, Tukatongue Thallid, Yavimaya Sapherd: bodies that leave more bodies behind.
Intangible Virtue (+1/+1 and vigilance for tokens), Sporecrown Thallid (Saprolings and Fungi +1/+1), Chapel Geist in the air.
Midnight Haunting at the end of the opponent’s turn for two fliers, then swing with everything.
keys: Every token gets +1/+1 and vigilance: the deck’s engine.
Instant: two 1/1 flying Spirits at the end of the opponent’s turn.
tips: Doomed Traveler and Tukatongue Thallid leave a token when they die: trade them freely.
Owlbear draws a card when it enters.
Giant Growth wins a combat or saves a creature from damage-based removal.
mulligan: Keep hands with both colors (or a way to them), 2–4 lands and two cheap creatures.
